items.facts: web/e2e/player.e2e.ts, case 'a music font that arrives after the 60 s backstop clears the error' (title at line 230). page.clock lines: 243 `  await page.clock.install();` | 249 `    await page.clock.fastForward(61_000);` | 252 `  await page.clock.resume();`. No runFor, pauseAt or setFixedTime. toPass block (248-251): `  await expect(async () => {` / `    await page.clock.fastForward(61_000);` / `    await expect(page.getByTestId('engine-error')).toContainText('Error E204', { timeout: 1000 });` / `  }).toPass({ timeout: 20_000 });`. Playwright 1.61.1 docs (playwright-core types/types.d.ts:18454): fastForward 'Only fires due timers at most once.'; runFor (18535) 'Advance the clock, firing all the time-related callbacks.' Code (playwright-core lib/coreBundle.js, embedded clock source): _innerFastForwardTo does `for (const timer of this._timers.values()) { if (to > timer.callAt) timer.callAt = to; }` then `await this._runTo(to);`, and _takeFirstTimer reschedules an Interval with `timer.callAt = shiftTicks(timer.callAt, timer.delay);` (to + delay, past `to`), so one firing per jump. runFor does `await this._runTo(shiftTicks(this._now.ticks, ticks));` with no bump, and _runTo loops `while (true) { const result = await this._callFirstTimer(to); if (!result.timerFound) break;`, so an interval fires once per period (61 times for 61000 ms). Measured on a scratch page (1 s visible-seconds interval, same install-then-goto order): fastForward(61000) x3 gave counter 1, 2, 3; the plan's retry shape for 20 s gave 40 of 60 and no E204; one runFor(61000) gave 60 and E204 in 0.33 s. Clock install: `page.clock.install()` with no pauseAt leaves the clock running in real time (log replay ends with `this._innerResume()`), and both calls run inside _runWithDisabledRealTimeSync, so runFor works and leaves the same state as fastForward; the later `page.clock.resume()` stays valid. Advisory: runFor fires every due timer, not only the tick. With a requestAnimationFrame loop alive the scratch page took 19 s (3813 callbacks). web/ and AlphaTab 1.8.4 call rAF only one-shot, or in a bounded scroll animation, while the font is held (PlayerShell.tsx:86 and :460, live-settings.ts:79, alphaTab.core.mjs:41290 and :41444), so it should be fast, but I did not run the real app; Step 3's run of this case is the check.

An sntrys_ token needs no org (`!options.org && !options.authToken.startsWith("sntrys_")`). options.errorHandler is called only in handleRecoverableError (102-126), reached from catch blocks (321, 340, 476, 524) and from a failed validateOptions (128); validateOptions rejects only bad setCommits, deploy, and an empty or invalid project ARRAY, not a missing project (options-mapping.js 73-113).
